Ingredients: 200g flour, 300ml milk, 2 eggs, 1 tbsp sugar, pinch of salt
Cooking_Instructions: Mix flour, sugar and salt | Whisk in milk and eggs | Fry ladles of batter until golden on both sides

Ingredients: 4 eggs, 400g tomatoes, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tsp cumin, salt
Cooking_Instructions: Fry onion and garlic | Add tomatoes and cumin and simmer | Crack in eggs and cover until set

Ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, 1 romaine lettuce, 50g parmesan, 100g croutons, 4 tbsp caesar dressing
Cooking_Instructions: Grill the chicken | Chop lettuce and slice chicken | Toss with dressing, parmesan and croutons

Ingredients: 250g chickpeas, 1 onion, 3 cloves garlic, 1 tsp cumin, 4 pita breads, 2 tomatoes
Cooking_Instructions: Blend chickpeas, onion, garlic and cumin | Shape into balls and fry | Serve in pita with tomatoes

Ingredients: 1kg chicken, 500g basmati rice, 2 onions, 3 tomatoes, 2 tbsp baharat, 1 dried lime, salt
Cooking_Instructions: Brown the onions and chicken | Add tomatoes, baharat and dried lime with water | Simmer until chicken is tender | Cook rice in the broth

Ingredients: 400g spaghetti, 500g minced beef, 1 onion, 400g tomatoes, 2 cloves garlic, salt
Cooking_Instructions: Brown the beef with onion and garlic | Add tomatoes and simmer | Boil the spaghetti | Combine and serve

Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate, 150g butter, 200g sugar, 3 eggs, 100g flour
Cooking_Instructions: Melt chocolate and butter | Whisk in sugar and eggs | Fold in flour | Bake at 180C for 25 minutes

Ingredients: 2 apples, 2 bananas, 200g strawberries, 1 orange, 1 tbsp honey
Cooking_Instructions: Chop all the fruit | Add orange juice and honey | Toss and chill
